infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: EventsTrack tracks your location while you are checked in to a work site to verify geofence compliance.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EventsTrack uses your location to verify you are inside the work site before checking in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: EventsTrack monitors your location while checked in to detect if you leave the site.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: EventsTrack needs location access to verify you are inside the work site and to track your presence during your shift.
